name: From bioengineering on Earth to pioneering healthcare in space
description: We'll dive into the emerging world of space biotechnology and explore how navigating unconventional paths, embracing unexpected opportunities, and leveraging a single powerful connection can take a career further than ever imagined, on Earth and beyond!

name: #IAmRemarkable Workshop
description: Do you ever struggle to talk about your accomplishments? You aren't alone. Whether it's imposter syndrome, cultural norms, or outdated stereotypes, many of us find self-promotion uncomfortable - but it's a critical skill for career growth and personal confidence.

name: Attopting The Right AI-ttitude At Work And In Private Live
description: Networking with amazing women across all roles.

name: No One Path: Three Tech Career Stories
description: An evening of real talk and practical inspiration for women of all ages and abilities. Three speakers share how they entered tech: a traditional route, an unconventional pivot in the mid-20s, and a complete career switch in the mid-30s. Come for the stories, stay for the Q&A and community.
